answer: Each agent locks 80 POA as a nectar stake, vine-bound for 14 days; idle accounts that wander without completing a task each epoch lose 10% of their bond to the common pool. A sybil operator running 400 ghost identities must lock 400 x 80 = 32,000 POA and keep all 400 active, or watch them drain. Honest agents recover their full bond through verified contributions.
